body:
Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-26 04:35Z; my own slip on w-4018, GREEN test-2261f284). Stage the exact input BEFORE the focused run that serves as READY evidence, then freeze and review that same staged state.

The launcher fingerprint includes the index (ls-files --stage), `git status` and the untracked-content hash. So `git add` after the run gives the frozen input a different composite fingerprint (6c74 vs 9b8a) even when no byte changed, and the integrator cannot accept "same tree" as an assertion.

Recovery: rebuild the run's input.json components from git objects only, using the launcher's own captureFingerprint/compositeFingerprint from that commit. Script: .evidence/handoff-opus3-2026-10-25/w-4018-green-provenance.mjs. Note that `git status --short` lists tracked changes before untracked ones; they are not interleaved by path. Then hand over per-component matches with blob hashes. Better: stage first, and the problem never arises.
